digest.component_or_area: code-review criteria routing and blocking posture
propositions: correctness and edge-cases dimensions lack explicit routing entries in criteria_routing.json and resolve through the unknown-criterion default of 0.95 threshold, not blocking

measured block-impact at 0.54 threshold shows correctness at 4.04% and edge-cases at 1.74% of all changes would block, both within the 8.0% operator-accepted friction budget recorded on the tests entry
concurrency is routed but advisory with blocking_enabled false; at 0.54 it would block zero changes and is below the calibration script's MIN_N=25 power floor

the replay_code_v4_would_block.py script hard-codes a _BLOCKING_SET literal that cannot drift from packaged routing postures and must be derived from registry.routing_index() filtered on blocking_enabled
adding correctness and edge-cases to routing widens registry.effective_criteria() via the canonical vocabulary lambda, making them previewable and eval-addressable
